cloud.imageSetup: curl -fsSL https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-7.0.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-7.0.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-7.0.gpg] http://repo.mongodb.org/apt/debian bookworm/mongodb-org/7.0 main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mongodb-org-7.0.list && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mongodb-org-server mongodb-mongosh && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
